name: Normal operation
description: All readings in target range, no trend, nothing broken.

name: Filter run ending — backwash due
description: Turbidity at 0.25 NTU, headloss 8 psi over clean, or 72 h run time. Includes short runs during breakup or turnover.

name: Persistent or recurring filter failure
description: Above 0.3 NTU after two backwashes, same filter problem 3 times in 30 days, sand in clearwell, or runs shortening out of season.

name: Low or falling chlorine residual
description: Chlorine 0.2–0.5 mg/L, or falling 3+ days in a row (3.5). Empty day tank, weak or old batch, worn pump.

name: Chlorine below 0.2 mg/L
description: Entry-point free chlorine below the EPA minimum of 0.2 mg/L.

name: High chlorine residual
description: Chlorine above 2.0 mg/L. Above 4.0 mg/L (EPA maximum) is an emergency.

name: Filtered turbidity above 1.0 NTU
description: Bench-confirmed filtered turbidity above the EPA limit of 1.0 NTU.

name: Instrument error or false reading
description: Online meter disagrees with bench meter by more than 0.1 NTU, or a reading is stuck (often a frozen sample line, 6.3).

name: pH out of target range
description: pH below 6.8 or above 8.0, usually a soda ash feed problem. Outside 6.5–8.5 is an emergency (5.4).

name: Low loop temperature or circulation pump trouble
description: Loop return water below 40°F, circulation pump stopped, or boiler fault, with circulation restored.

name: Frozen main or loss of circulation
description: Part of the loop not circulating for more than 2 hours in freezing weather, or a frozen or broken line.

name: Pump failure or chemical feed loss of prime
description: A pump won't run (standby available), breaker trip, or a chemical feed pump lost prime (7.3).

name: Low distribution pressure or main break
description: Pressure below 20 psi anywhere in the system, or a main break.
